_comment: Synchronized from OpenAPI by `SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo run -- generate-mcp-docs`. Existing MCP wording is preserved; use `--force` to regenerate everything.

arguments.community_id: Community ID (the `id` of a community in list_servers), or "all" for every community combined.
arguments.time: RFC 3339 timestamp for the newest bucket to return.

get_community_player_count_graph.description: Return up to 32 time-series buckets of unique player counts for one community or all communities combined. Use this to compare recent activity at 10-minute, hourly, or daily resolution.
get_community_player_count_graph.title: Community Player Counts

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_analysis.description: Return a map's performance summary, including player drop-off, average session length, total playtime, session count, and related activity metrics.
get_map_analysis.title: Map Performance Summary

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_heat_regions.description: Return daily geographic activity data for a map, suitable for a region heatmap showing where its players came from over time.
get_map_heat_regions.title: Map Activity Heatmap

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_info.description: Return detailed information about one map on a server, including when it first appeared, rotation status, classification, cooldowns, player limits, and Workshop metadata.
get_map_info.title: Map Details

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_player_types.description: Return how playtime on a map is divided among player types, such as casual, tryhard, and mixed players.
get_map_player_types.title: Map Playtime by Player Type

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_regions.description: Return a geographic breakdown of the players and playtime recorded for a map.
get_map_regions.title: Map Activity by Region

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_session_distribution.description: Return the distribution of session lengths for a map to show how long players typically remain connected while it is played.
get_map_session_distribution.title: Map Session Lengths

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_session_player_count_graph.description: Return the server's player-count time series during one play of a map. The result preserves peaks while limiting the chart to at most 1,500 points.
get_map_session_player_count_graph.title: Map Session Player Counts

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_session_players.description: Return the players in one map session, ranked by the time they played during that session. Players who chose privacy appear anonymous unless the requester is allowed to identify them.
get_map_session_players.title: Players in a Map Session

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.page: Zero-based page number; each page contains 5 sessions.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_sessions.description: List a map's play sessions on a server, newest first, with 5 sessions per page. Each result includes the session ID needed by the map-session tools.
get_map_sessions.title: Map Play History

arguments.map_name: Exact map name, e.g. ze_example_v1. Use search_maps to resolve partial names.
arguments.page: Zero-based page number; each page contains up to 10 players.
arguments.player_name: Optional case-insensitive player-name search containing at least 2 characters.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_map_top_players.description: List players ranked by their total playtime on a map. Optionally search by player name; results contain up to 10 players per page.
get_map_top_players.title: Top Players for a Map

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_detail.description: Return a player's full profile for one server, including their name, total playtime, rank, session activity, and related statistics.
get_player_detail.title: Player Profile

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID) returned by a player search tool, or `me` for the signed-in player.

get_player_global_playtime_heatmap.description: Return a player's daily playtime summed across all tracked servers. Use `player_id = "me"` for the signed-in player; activity from communities where the player chose privacy is omitted unless the requester has permission.
get_player_global_playtime_heatmap.title: Global Player Playtime Heatmap

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_hours_of_day.description: Return a player's server activity grouped by hour of day, showing when they most often join and leave.
get_player_hours_of_day.title: Player Activity by Hour

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_infractions.description: List a player's recorded bans and mutes on a server, newest first, including the reason, issuer, time, and status when available.
get_player_infractions.title: Player Infractions

arguments.mode: Playtime category used for ranking: `Casual`, `TryHard`, `Mixed`, or `Total`.
arguments.page: Zero-based page number; each page contains up to 5 players.
arguments.player_name: Optional case-insensitive player-name search containing at least 2 characters.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_leaderboard.description: List a server's players ranked by casual, tryhard, mixed, or total playtime. Optionally search by name; results contain up to 5 players per page and respect each player's privacy setting.
get_player_leaderboard.title: Server Player Leaderboard

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_most_played_maps.description: Return the maps a player has spent the most time playing on a server, ranked by playtime.
get_player_most_played_maps.title: Player's Most-Played Maps

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_online_heatmap.description: Return a player's server activity grouped by weekday and hour for use in an online-activity heatmap.
get_player_online_heatmap.title: Player Activity Heatmap

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_regions.description: Return a player's playtime on a server grouped by geographic region.
get_player_regions.title: Player Playtime by Region

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_session_player_count_graph.description: Return the server's player-count time series during one player's session. The result preserves peaks while limiting the chart to at most 1,500 points.
get_player_session_player_count_graph.title: Player Session Player Counts

arguments.datetime: Optional RFC 3339 timestamp marking the start of the 24-hour window to list; omit it to search all records since 2024-02-01.
arguments.page: Zero-based page number; each page contains up to 10 sessions.
arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_sessions.description: List a player's sessions on a server, newest first, with up to 10 sessions per page. Supply `datetime` for a specific 24-hour window or omit it to include all available history.
get_player_sessions.title: Player Session History

arguments.player_id: Player ID (usually a Steam64 ID), as returned by the player search tools.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_player_sessions_graph.description: Return a player's session history as time-series chart data, with playtime summarized into dated buckets.
get_player_sessions_graph.title: Player Session History Chart

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_current_match.description: Return the map currently being played on a server and its live match state, including round information when available.
get_server_current_match.title: Current Server Match

arguments.end: Inclusive end of the range as an RFC 3339 timestamp; must be no more than 1 day after `start`.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.
arguments.start: Inclusive start of the range as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

get_server_event_count_graph.description: Return a time series of player joins or leaves on a server over a range of up to 1 day. Events are counted by minute and summarized to roughly 360 chart points.
get_server_event_count_graph.title: Server Join and Leave Activity

arguments.end: Inclusive end of the range as an RFC 3339 timestamp; must be no more than 2 days after `start`.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.
arguments.start: Inclusive start of the range as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

get_server_maps_played_graph.description: List the map sessions played on a server during a date range of up to 2 days, including each map's start and end times.
get_server_maps_played_graph.title: Server Map History

arguments.end: Inclusive end of the range as an RFC 3339 timestamp; must be no more than 1 year after `start`.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.
arguments.start: Inclusive start of the range as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

get_server_player_count_graph.description: Return the server's player-count time series over a range of up to 1 year. The bucket size adjusts automatically from 5 minutes for short ranges to 2 days for year-long ranges.
get_server_player_count_graph.title: Server Player Counts

arguments.end: Inclusive end of the ranking window as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
arguments.page: Zero-based page number; each page contains up to 70 players.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.
arguments.start: Optional start of the ranking window as an RFC 3339 timestamp; defaults to the server's earliest recorded session.

get_server_players_in_range.description: List a server's players ranked by playtime within a custom date range, with up to 70 players per page. Player names respect each player's privacy setting.
get_server_players_in_range.title: Server Players by Date Range

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_stats.description: Return a server's total playtime, unique-player count, and country count for both all-time history and the last week.
get_server_stats.title: Server Activity Summary

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

get_server_top_players.description: Return the top 20 players on a server by playtime during a preset period ranging from today to the last year. Player names respect each player's privacy setting.
get_server_top_players.title: Server Top Players

arguments.filter: Optional map filter: `Casual`, `TryHard`, `Available`, `Favorite`, or `HasLaser`. `Favorite` requires the requester's bearer token.
arguments.page: Zero-based page number; each page contains up to 25 maps.
arguments.search_map: Optional case-insensitive substring to match against map names.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

list_maps.description: List maps played on a server with sorting, category filtering, and name search. Results include activity and classification details and contain up to 25 maps per page.
list_maps.title: Browse Server Maps

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

list_online_players.description: List players currently connected to a server. A player remains online for up to 20 minutes after their last verification; names respect each player's privacy setting.
list_online_players.title: Online Players

list_servers.description: List every tracked Zombie Escape community and server. Use this first to discover the `server_id`, readable link, current map, online status, player count, and capacity required by other tools.
list_servers.title: Communities and Servers

arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

list_time_regions.description: List the geographic region labels used by map and player region charts. The server ID is used to validate the request, while the returned region set is shared across servers.
list_time_regions.title: List Geographic Regions

arguments.map: Case-insensitive map-name substring to search for.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

search_maps.description: Search a server's known maps by a partial, case-insensitive name. Returns up to 20 matches whose exact names can be passed to other map tools.
search_maps.title: Search Server Maps

arguments.player_name: Case-insensitive player-name substring containing at least 3 characters.
arguments.server_id: Server ID or the server's readable_link, as returned by list_servers.

search_players.description: Search for players on one server by a partial name of at least 3 characters. Returns up to 20 matches and respects each player's privacy setting.
search_players.title: Search Server Players

arguments.page: Zero-based page number; each page contains up to 10 players.
arguments.search: Optional case-insensitive player-name substring containing at least 2 characters.

search_players_global.description: Search players across all tracked communities, or omit the search text to browse them by total playtime. Results contain up to 10 players per page.
search_players_global.title: Search Players Across Communities
